title: Bin El Ouidane reservoir, 14 Sep to 26 Sep 2026
summary: From 14 Sep to 26 Sep 2026 the lake went from 30.17 km2 to 29.82 km2, a change of -1.2%. The land around it was quiet, with 0.31 km2 brighter and 0.25 km2 darker in HV.

sections.heading: What changed
sections.text: Over 12 days the lake lost 0.35 km2. Mean HV moved by 0.03 dB and mean HH by -0.04 dB. In HH, 0.41 km2 turned brighter by more than 3 dB and 0.44 km2 darker.

sections.heading: Where, by terrain type
sections.text: The changing fields type fell by 0.98 dB in HV on average, the largest change of any type, on a very small area. Trees, shrub and rugged slopes had 0.13 km2 brighter and 0.1 km2 darker in HV. Smooth bare ground fell by 0.29 dB in HH.

sections.heading: Possible causes
sections.text: Possible cause for the lake: slow drawdown for irrigation and evaporation; the dam's level record would confirm it. Possible cause for the changing fields: a harvest on a few plots, which removes the plants that scatter HV; a field visit would check it.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.text: Neither date carries a flag. Lake areas are approximate: 9.7% and 9.2% of the outline falls on land in the optical photo. One track only, so slopes facing away from the radar can fall in shadow.

sections.heading: What an agency could do next
sections.text: Read this pair as the quiet end of summer and use these two dates as the reference for the autumn dates. Compare the 0.35 km2 loss with the dam's level change over the same 12 days.
